edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Nevermove has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Viktor Gravity Field: 17s at rank 1, 13s max — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it; its downtime is your all-in window. - Hextech Ray runs 12s down to 8s — step up right after he clears with it. - Your E Nevermove is 12s; his R Arcane Storm is 120s — spend yours on his commit.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: Vision of Empire reaches over 5500 units and slows — throw it on his retreat path once a root connects and the Q follow-up cannot be sidestepped.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: Half-HP is exactly where his Q shield-poke and Hextech Ray finish the job — reset or hug the wave until Demonic Ascension is up.

edits.before: W completes the setup: vision + slow from across the map. Root-into-W never misses, and the passive soul fragments heal you.
edits.after: His Hextech Ray pokes you off every last-hit and clears free; your W setup exists, but he controls the wave and you pay HP to use it.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-spam stops costing the lane. Poke the wave contact and pull every rooted target with the passive.
edits.after: He owns 4-5: E clears waves for free and Gravity Field zones your walk-up. Farm from range and bank mana for the level-6 turn.
